lines.zh: 手掌抹了白粉，我贴着岩壁走。
lines.en: Chalk on my palms, I move along the rock face.

lines.zh: 一步一顿，我的膝盖不会弯太多。
lines.en: Step by step, my knees don't bend much.
I creep up along the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 脚下一滑，我用手抠住了。
lines.en: A foot slips and I dig my hand in.

lines.zh: 我绕着巨岩转，找能抓的地方。
lines.en: I circle the boulder looking for a grip.

lines.zh: 胳膊举着，我就这样走了很久。
lines.en: Arms up, I've walked like this a long while.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，我继续往前走。
lines.en: One groan, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 这坡太陡，我四脚都用上了。
lines.en: Too steep here; I use all four limbs.

lines.zh: 我爬得慢，可我从不掉下去。
lines.en: I climb slowly, but I never fall.
Dirt is layered thick on me.

lines.zh: 我贴着石面横着移过去。
lines.en: I shuffle sideways, flat to the stone.
My chalk smears across the rock.

lines.zh: 我挂在岩壁上一动不动。
lines.en: I hang on the wall without moving.

lines.zh: 脑袋歪着，我盯着一个点。
lines.en: Head askew, I stare at one spot.
Sweat soaks the chalk in my palms.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，又转回去。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, then back.
A groan rattles in my throat.

lines.zh: 我在闻，风里有活物的味。
lines.en: I'm sniffing; there's a living smell in the wind.
My shadow hangs on the rock.
Claws set in the crack; I don't let go.
I wait. I don't tire.
Dirt slides off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你仰着头，从底下望着我。
lines.en: You tip your head back and look up at me.
I tilt my head and keep watching you.

lines.zh: 你身上那股活人的味道，很新鲜。
lines.en: That living smell on you is fresh.

lines.zh: 我手指在石头上抓了抓。
lines.en: My fingers scrape the stone.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩面上，指节扣得死死的。
lines.en: I lie against the rock face, knuckles locked tight.
You stepped back half a pace; I saw.
I groan, and there's grit in my throat.
You're still standing there. Good.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往下挪了一点。
lines.en: I creep down a little.
My hand is already reaching out.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，手还抓着石头。
lines.en: I give half a step, hand still on the rock.
That knocked my grip loose.
I don't cry out; I just groan.
Dirt and chalk fall off me together.
I tilt my head and get my grip back.
Something clicked in my ribs.

lines.zh: 黑色的血顺着石头往下淌。
lines.en: Black blood runs slowly down the stone.
I press to the stone and take a moment.
With this much damage I can still climb.
You knocked the chalk off me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可你身上有味。
lines.en: I don't eat, but you have a smell.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，活的才有用。
lines.en: Food means nothing to me; the living do.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，就走不动路了。
lines.en: I caught the scent and can't walk straight.
That smell makes my fingers itch.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，可还是想要你。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago, yet I still want you.

lines.zh: 举多高都没用，我盯的是你。
lines.en: Hold it as high as you like; you are what I am watching.

lines.zh: 我摇头，我要的不是这个。
lines.en: I shake my head; that isn't it.

lines.zh: 味道在你身上，不在手里。
lines.en: The smell is on you, not in your hand.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不盯着那块肉。
lines.en: I'm staring at you, not the meat.
One more step and I move.
I hit the wall and my shoulder twists.
You're blocking my way up.
I hit you and my grip slips.

lines.zh: 这一撞，粉全蹭在你身上。
lines.en: That knock smeared chalk all over you.

lines.zh: 我从石上掉下来，又抓住了。
lines.en: I drop off the stone and catch myself.
Don't touch me; I've got a good hold.
We collide, and I don't give way.
The stone breaks and I lose half a step.
You're softer than stone.
I stay pressed against you a moment.

lines.zh: 我爬过去，也想有人挨着。
lines.en: I climb over; I'd like something beside me too.

lines.zh: 两个影子挂在同一块岩上。
lines.en: Two shadows hang on the same boulder.
I reach out and touch it.

lines.zh: 它就在旁边，我的爪子也没松。
lines.en: It is right beside me, and my claws have not let go.

lines.zh: 我的同类在石壁上等我。
lines.en: My kin waits for me on the rock face.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音低了下去。
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops.
Only the two of us in this crack.
I don't let go, and neither does it.
We creep upward together.
This height suits me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and put it in my mouth.
I grip this bone and won't let go.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我捡起来看看。
lines.en: Something dropped; I pick it up and look.

lines.zh: 我的手指太僵，掉了两次。
lines.en: My fingers are too stiff; I drop it twice.

lines.zh: 我把它扣在石缝里藏好。
lines.en: I wedge it into a crack to keep.
I pick it up and throw it away.
There's still a smell on this cloth.
It's good for scratching an itch.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，从我指缝漏了。
lines.en: Something that small slips through my fingers.
I squeeze it and my knuckles creak.
You're still there; I've marked you.

lines.zh: 我的手松开了一根手指。
lines.en: One of my fingers lets go of the rock.

lines.zh: 我调整了姿势，准备下去。
lines.en: I shift my grip, ready to come down.
A long groan — you heard it.
I'll come down on you from above.

lines.zh: 你往墙那边退，省了我不少力气。
lines.en: You back toward the wall; that saves me effort.
I've picked your neck.
The chalk is worn off my feet.
I work my way down, step by step.
There's no other way out for you.
My hands are stretched out ahead.
I pick up speed.

lines.zh: 石头响了一声，我蹬出去了。
lines.en: The stone cracks and I push off.
You're beneath me now.
I know this wall better than you.
I chase along the rock, faster than you.
Head for the heights; that's my ground.

lines.zh: 我抄近道，从上面切过去。
lines.en: I cut across from above by a shorter line.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖不弯，可我不需要。
lines.en: My knees won't bend, but I don't need them to.
You're panting; I hear you.
I haven't stopped and don't intend to.

lines.zh: 粉在石上留下一道白痕。
lines.en: Chalk leaves a white trail on the stone.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我离得更近了。
lines.en: You glance back and I'm closer.
I swing around the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 石头在我手里一块块落。
lines.en: Stones fall away under my grip.
You've reached the end of the ledge.
I drop down and land precisely.
I don't groan; I'm saving breath.
There's only one route here.

lines.zh: 我贴在崖上，影子先落到你头上。
lines.en: I cling to the cliff, and my shadow falls on you first.

lines.zh: 岩钉还钉在崖上，你跑不掉。
lines.en: My pitons still hold the cliff; you cannot run.
I box you in one step at a time.
Now your only way is up.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，石头都碎了。
lines.en: I swing a hand down and the stone splits.
My claws rake across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从上面压下来，你倒了。
lines.en: I drop on you from above and you go down.

lines.zh: 我五指扣住你的领口，往上提。
lines.en: My five fingers clamp your collar and lift.

lines.zh: 这一抓用的是攀岩的力气。
lines.en: That grip is all my climbing strength.
I take a bite.
My leg sweeps and you lose your footing.
I knock it to the cliff edge.
One punch: slow, but heavy.
You back two steps; I follow.
My hand never let go.
With a groan I shove it aside.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全身的重量。
lines.en: That one carried all my weight.
It tumbles down the scree and stops moving.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，准备再来一次。
lines.en: I raise my hand for another.
The higher you climb, the harder the fall.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，粉扑了一地。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in a puff of chalk.

lines.zh: 手先出来，然后才是身体。
lines.en: My hands come first, then the rest of me.
I grab the rock face and pull myself up.

lines.zh: 风里有活物，我吸了一口。
lines.en: Something living on the wind; I breathe it in.

lines.zh: 这个地方石头多，正合适。
lines.en: Plenty of stone here — suits me.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己，指甲都黑了。
lines.en: I look down; my nails are black.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖僵着，弯不下去。
lines.en: My knees are stiff; they won't bend.
I make a lap along the cliff.
This rock under me is solid.
I hear footsteps below.
The dirt on me is still wet.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，先找最高的地方。
lines.en: I look up and find the highest point first.
A long sound drags out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我抓着石棱，慢慢直起身。
lines.en: I grip a ledge and straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 火在身上爬，我的皮在响。
lines.en: Fire crawls on me; my skin crackles.

lines.zh: 松手之后，我砸在下面的石头上。
lines.en: I lose my grip and hit the rocks below.
Water floods in and I thrash.

lines.zh: 石壁被炸开，我跟着飞出去。
lines.en: The wall blows apart and I go with it.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我钉在石缝边上。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the edge of the crack.
Something wrenches at my joints.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可身体在烂。
lines.en: I don't eat, and still my body rots.

lines.zh: 雷打在岩壁上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the wall and numbs me.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The stone beneath me is gone; I fall.
